title: ComorbiditiesMedicationsAllergies
description: Conditions, medication orders/records (with administration setting) and allergies. v2.1 adds medications[].administration_setting + verbatim setting_basis (required) and optional order_role / medication_id. Legacy schema_version "2" archives are read leniently by validate_structured_outputs.py (WARN, not FAIL).

provenance.description: prior_archive = restated from a prior_archive_digest source (earlier organize archive, original not in this packet); history only, never current status.

use_status.description: Source wording only (organizer-prompt-phase2-synthesis.md §5.2). An imaging-request indication 'on X' / '正在使用 X' is active_reported (a clinician document says the drug is in use; it is not an administration record, so never active_confirmed). A single day-ward administration is not active_confirmed. Self-reported use produces no medications[] row.

medication_id.description: Optional stable id (e.g. MED-001) so treatment_lines.episodes[].medication_refs can point at this row.

administration_setting.description: Where/how the source says the drug was given. Only two rules assign a value (organizer-prompt-phase2-synthesis.md §5.2): day_ward = the page's department / ward name states a day unit (日间病房 / 日间治疗中心 / 日间化疗, incl. a specialty's 日间化疗; day ward / day-chemo unit — a specialty name or 门诊 alone is not one) and the row is iv/im or 配-marked; discharge = the row sits under a 出院带药 heading; everything else = unknown. inpatient and long_term are RESERVED values: the current rules never assign them (write unknown); they stay in the enum only so earlier archives remain readable. Not use_status: a day-ward single administration is not an active home medication.

setting_basis.description: Verbatim source cue for administration_setting (department line, list heading, route/配 marker). Required non-empty unless administration_setting is unknown.

order_role.description: Optional role of the row within its source order list (flush / carrier saline or glucose = diluent; anti-allergy / antiemetic given before an infusion = premedication; 必要时 antiemetic / gastric protection = supportive). Antineoplastic rows are ALSO recorded in treatment_lines.json with the same source_refs.
